verdict.rationale: Gladia's pricing page publishes per-hour base rates by model and volume tier (0.27€/hr Solaria-1, 0.16€/hr Solaria-3 at 0-100 hrs/month). It also itemizes add-ons per hour (summarization, sentiment, translation, NER, PII redaction) and offers a cost calculator, so an agent can compute a job's cost before submitting it. Missing for 10: full higher-tier rate values (only described as 'falling by tier'), explicit real-time/live pricing, a machine-readable or API-accessible pricing source for agents, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized

citations.quote: Itemized add-ons per hour: Summarization +0.03€/h, Sentiment analysis +0.02€/h, Translation +0.05€/h, Named entity recognition +0.07€/h, PII redaction (async only) +0.07€/h.
